description: A full-stack web application that allows users to save birthdays of friends and family, and sends automated SMS reminders using Twilio API. It includes a dashboard to manage contacts, customizable messages, and scheduling options. Built for both personal and team use, especially useful in corporate environments to maintain relationships.

A subscription-based service platform designed for small businesses. Users can browse service packages, subscribe monthly, and manage their accounts. Includes secure payment integration, admin dashboards, and responsive UI/UX optimized for both desktop and mobile.

A modern cleaning service web app allowing customers to book recurring or one-time cleaning services. The platform supports different subscription levels, booking management, real-time availability check, and customer profile customization.

A car configurator tool where users can build their desired car model from scratch. It includes options to change colors, rims, interiors, and more. The interface is interactive and animated using Framer Motion, giving a real-time preview of configurations.

A travel exploration website that allows users to discover new destinations and subscribe to a newsletter for weekly curated travel content. It includes featured destinations, travel tips, and integrations with Mailchimp for newsletter management.

An enterprise-level application for managing multiple construction sites. It features task assignment, staff tracking, equipment logs, safety protocols, and progress reporting. Designed to improve operational efficiency and on-site coordination.
